video:video.video:title: Pre-call research in 90 seconds
video:video.video:description: Reps rebuild context from a dozen tabs before every call: news, org changes, the annual report and whatever is buried in the CRM. One prompt pulls public and internal context into a one-page call plan with three angles to lead with and the opening question to ask.

video:video.video:title: Deal review prep from call recordings
video:video.video:description: Front-line managers listen to hours of calls to find the real risk in a deal before each review. A one-page risk brief per deal, with the buyer quotes that prove each risk and the question to put to the rep.

video:video.video:title: Product launch training video in a day
video:video.video:description: Launch training lands weeks after the launch, so reps learn the new story from customers. A narrated, on-brand training video ready on launch day, built from the launch brief.

video:video.video:title: Follow-up email before you leave the call
video:video.video:description: Follow-ups go out late and generic, and buyers forget what they agreed to. A recap written in the buyer's own words, with next steps, owners and dates, sent while the call is still fresh.

video:video.video:title: Forecast commentary in one click
video:video.video:description: Sales leaders hand-write the weekly forecast narrative from spreadsheet exports. A drafted commentary that explains the week's movement in plain language, ready to edit and post to the leadership channel.

video:video.video:title: Discovery questions from a 10-K
video:video.video:description: Discovery questions stay generic because nobody has time to read the annual report. Five questions grounded in what the CFO already told investors, each tied to a metric they are measured on.

video:video.video:title: Mutual action plan from one transcript
video:video.video:description: Deals stall in late stage because nobody owns the path to signature. A shared plan with milestones, owners on both sides and dates the buyer can edit with you.

video:video.video:title: Coaching scorecards on every call
video:video.video:description: Managers can only review a handful of calls, so coaching depends on luck. Every call scored against the team rubric, with one timestamped coaching moment and a five-minute drill.

video:video.video:title: Objection roleplay with an AI buyer
video:video.video:description: Reps meet the toughest objections for the first time in front of real buyers. A skeptical AI buyer built from real call objections, available any time, that scores the rep when the roleplay ends.

video:video.video:title: Win-loss themes from 40 interviews
video:video.video:description: Win-loss interviews pile up unread, so the pitch never changes. Ranked themes with quotes, by segment, and three concrete changes to make to the talk track.

video:video.video:title: Battlecards that refresh themselves
video:video.video:description: Battlecards go stale the week after they ship. A Monday digest of competitor moves with the updated talk track, posted where reps already work.

video:video.video:title: A new rep's first week, rebuilt
video:video.video:description: New hires drown in links and decks in week one and still cannot answer basic customer questions. A personalised five-day path that answers their questions in context and checks understanding each day.
